_doc: Machine-readable manifest of every HARD rule in spec/CLAUDE*.md (v9.0.0: 15 rules; 11 removed, see spec/CLAUDE-changelog.md). `enforcement` says how each is checked (hook / self / both / external); `rule_hits_section` names the log section a hook writes for it, or null. spec_version here is the canonical spec version (scripts/version-cascade-check.js). Maintenance: when spec adds/removes a HARD rule, update this manifest in the same commit. tests/scripts/hard-rules-drift.test.js asserts each entry's section_anchor exists in the named spec file.

rules.name: Ask first: the listed ops need the [AUTH REQUIRED] line
Core growth discipline: size caps + outcome evidence for new rules
rules.note: Enforced mechanically for spec edits: tests/scripts/spec-structure.test.js fails past either byte cap. Lives in §EXT §13 META since v6.36.0 (spec-editing only).

rules.name: Iron Law #2: no done without a check run this session
rules.section_anchor: Say done, fixed or passing only after running the check in this session

rules.name: Ship-baseline check
rules.section_anchor: - **CI baseline**: before a push that fires CI

rules.name: Temp files: scratchpad, delete what you created elsewhere
rules.section_anchor: Temporary files go in the session scratchpad

rules.name: rm -rf $VAR safety (immutable)
rules.section_anchor: on a variable that could be empty: guard it

rules.name: NPX unpinned package safety
rules.section_anchor: `npx` of a package with no lockfile or local install

rules.name: curl/wget piped into a shell (unknown-origin execution)
Report shape: 汇报 with 变更 → 验证 → 遗留, one verdict word per check
Banned vocabulary in commit messages (hook-enforced)
rules.note: Hook enforces the banned-vocab subset on two paths, not one: Path 1 scans the git-commit message against the whole pattern file; Path 2 (BANNED_VOCAB_PROSE_SCAN, default ON since v0.21.0) scans the prior assistant turn's prose when the command is a ship verb and denies on it, but only against the high-fire region of the pattern file; the prophylactic patterns are not scanned by any hook since 0.123.0 removed transcript-vocab-scan. Agent self-enforces on all other text

rules.name: MEMORY.md read-the-file before ship/destructive commands (hook-enforced)
rules.note: Hook enforces the ship/release half only (memory-read-check.sh TRIGGER_RE covers git push / gh release / npm publish / cargo publish / make release / deploy / ship); the destructive-path and L3 triggers the rule also names are Agent-enforced. Corrected from enforcement=hook 2026-07-26: the field is what §13 META tells the agent to calibrate from, and it claimed mechanical coverage the hook does not have.

rules.name: Author ≠ reviewer (fresh subagent, empty context)
rules.section_anchor: - **Author ≠ reviewer**: the reviewer is a fresh subagent

rules.name: Ship from a runbook or skill; by hand → manual-ship line + checklist
rules.section_anchor: write `manual ship because <reason>` as the report

rules.name: One run: a ship request is one turn from commit to CI green
rules.section_anchor: - **One run**: one ship request covers commit, push, tag
